12816-the-devil-s-pool.title: Has Been Completely Translated
12816-the-devil-s-pool.creator: Unknown
12816-the-devil-s-pool.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The quatrain in old French written below one of Holbein's pictures is profoundly sad in its simplicity. The engraving represents a ploughman driving his plough through a field. A vast expanse of country stretches away in the distance, with some poor cabins here and there; the sun is setting behind the hill. It is the close of a hard day's work.

29177-the-pygmy-planet.title: The Pygmy Planet
29177-the-pygmy-planet.creator: Unknown
29177-the-pygmy-planet.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Agnes Sterling was a slender, elfish, dark-haired girl--lovely, he had thought her, on the occasions of their few brief meetings. Larry knew her as the secretary and laboratory assistant of Dr. Travis Whiting, a retired college professor known for his work on the structure of the atom. Larry had called at the home-laboratory of the savant, months before, to check certain statistics to be used for advertising purposes and had met the girl there. Only a few times since had he seen her.

arxiv-2109-11462.title: Acceleration based PSO for Multi-UAV Source-Seeking
arxiv-2109-11462.creator: Adithya Shankar, Harikumar Kandath, J. Senthilnath
arxiv-2109-11462.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel algorithm for a swarm of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to search for an unknown source. The proposed method is inspired by the well-known PSO algorithm and is called acceleration-based particle swarm optimization (APSO) to address the source-seeking problem with no a priori information.

arxiv-2211-05863.title: Buckling of lipidic ultrasound contrast agents under quasi-static load
arxiv-2211-05863.creator: Georges Chabouh 1, Benjamin van Elburg 2, Michel Versluis 2, Tim Segers 3, Catherine Quilliet 1, and Gwennou Coupier 1
arxiv-2211-05863.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Georges Chabouh 1, Benjamin van Elburg 2, Michel Versluis 2, Tim Segers 3, Catherine Quilliet 1, and Gwennou Coupier 1. Collapse of lipidic ultrasound contrast agents under high-frequency compressive load has been historically interpreted by the vanishing of surface tension. By contrast, buckling of elastic shells is known to occur when costly compressible stress is released through bending.

arxiv-2302-08223.title: Energy Efficient Operation of Adaptive Massive MIMO 5G HetNets
arxiv-2302-08223.creator: Siddarth Marwaha, Eduard A. Jorswieck, Mostafa Jassim, Thomas Kuerner, David Lopez Perez, Xilnli Geng, Harvey Bao
arxiv-2302-08223.description: Abstract For energy efficient operation of the massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) networks, various aspects of energy efficiency maximization have been addressed, where a careful selection of number of active antennas has shown significant gains. Moreover, switching-off physical resource blocks (PRBs) and carrier shutdown saves energy in low load scenarios.

arxiv-2305-01748.title: A note on asymmetric hypergraphs
arxiv-2305-01748.creator: Dominik Bohnert, Christian Winter
arxiv-2305-01748.description: Abstract A k k -graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is asymmetric if there does not exist an automorphism on 𝒢 \mathcal{G} other than the identity, and 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is called minimal asymmetric if it is asymmetric but every non-trivial induced sub-hypergraph of 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is non-asymmetric.

arxiv-2310-03663.title: Autoregressive Coefficients based Intelligent Protection of Transmission Lines Connected to Type-3 Wind Farms
arxiv-2310-03663.creator: Pallav Kumar Bera, Vajendra Kumar, Samita Rani Pani, Om P. Malik
arxiv-2310-03663.description: Abstract — Protective relays can mal-operate for transmission lines connected to doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based large capacity wind farms (WFs). The performance of distance relays protecting such lines is investigated and a statistical model based intelligent protection of the area between the grid and the WF is proposed in this article.

arxiv-2402-14764.title: A Combinatorial Central Limit Theorem for Stratified Randomization Thanks: The author thanks Xavier D’Haultfœuille for helpful discussions that led to this work.
arxiv-2402-14764.creator: Purevdorj Tuvaandorj
arxiv-2402-14764.description: Abstract This paper establishes a combinatorial central limit theorem for stratified randomization, which holds under a Lindeberg-type condition. The theorem allows for an arbitrary number or sizes of strata, with the sole requirement being that each stratum contains at least two units. This flexibility accommodates both a growing number of large and small strata simultaneously, while imposing minimal conditions.

arxiv-2403-04359.title: Symmetry Considerations for Learning Task Symmetric Robot Policies
arxiv-2403-04359.creator: Mayank Mittal, Nikita Rudin, Victor Klemm, Arthur Allshire, and Marco Hutter
arxiv-2403-04359.description: Abstract Symmetry is a fundamental aspect of many real-world robotic tasks. However, current deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches can seldom harness and exploit symmetry effectively. Often, the learned behaviors fail to achieve the desired transformation invariances and suffer from motion artifacts.

arxiv-2405-14125.title: ALI-Agent: Assessing LLMs'Alignment with Human Values via Agent-based Evaluation
arxiv-2405-14125.creator: Jingnan Zheng, Han Wang *, An Zhang, Tai D. Nguyen, Jun Sun, Tat-Seng Chua
arxiv-2405-14125.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) can elicit unintended and even harmful content when misaligned with human values, posing severe risks to users and society. To mitigate these risks, current evaluation benchmarks predominantly employ expert-designed contextual scenarios to assess how well LLMs align with human values.

arxiv-2503-08624.title: Light-by-Light scattering in ultraperipheral heavy ion collisions: Estimating inelastic contributions
arxiv-2503-08624.creator: Mariola Klusek-Gawenda, Victor P. Gonçalves, Antoni Szczurek
arxiv-2503-08624.description: Abstract The current state-of-the-art theoretical estimations lead to cross-sections for A ​ A → γ ​ γ ​ A ​ A AA\to\gamma\gamma AA which are somewhat smaller than the measured ones by the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations, which motivates the searching and calculation of subleading corrections disregarded in these previous studies.

arxiv-2602-06549.title: Refining the Information Bottleneck via Adversarial Information Separation
arxiv-2602-06549.creator: Shuai Ning, Zhenpeng Wang, Lin Wang, Bing Chen, Shuangrong Liu, Xu Wu, Jin Zhou, Bo Yang
arxiv-2602-06549.description: Abstract Generalizing from limited data is particularly critical for models in domains such as material science, where task-relevant features in experimental datasets are often heavily confounded by measurement noise and experimental artifacts. Standard regularization techniques fail to precisely separate meaningful features from noise, while existing adversarial adaptation methods are limited by their reliance on explicit separation labels.

pmc-10658452.title: Laser-Induced Graphitization of Polydopamine on Titania Nanotubes
pmc-10658452.creator: Adrian Olejnik, Krzysztof Polaczek, Marek Szkodo, Alicja Stanisławska, Jacek Ryl, Katarzyna Siuzdak
pmc-10658452.description: Since the discovery of laser-induced graphite/graphene, there has been a notable surge of scientific interest in advancing diverse methodologies for their synthesis and applications. This study focuses on the utilization of a pulsed Nd:YAG laser to achieve graphitization of polydopamine (PDA) deposited on the surface of titania nanotubes.

pmc-10683557.title: Recurrent diphtheria outbreaks in Nigeria: A review of the underlying factors and remedies
pmc-10683557.creator: Nasir Abdulrasheed, Lukman Lawal, Abdulazeez B Mogaji, Ahmed O Abdulkareem, Abdulrahman K Shuaib, Sodiq G Adeoti, Opeyemi P Amosu, Abdulmujeeb O Muhammad‐Olodo, Abdulwahab O Lawal, Tawakalitu A Jaji, Toufik Abdul‐Rahman
pmc-10683557.description: IntroductionThe introduction of the diphtheria−tetanus−pertussis (DTP) vaccine into childhood immunization programs resulted in its widespread elimination in high‐income countries. However, Nigeria is currently experiencing an outbreak. The primary cause of diphtheria outbreaks and its high mortality rates in Nigeria was waning herd immunity due to low DTP coverage and a lack of diphtheria antitoxin (DAT), respectively.

pmc-10735960.title: NEIGHBORHOOD SOCIOECONOMIC POSITION, LIVING ARRANGEMENTS, AND CARDIOMETABOLIC DISEASE AMONG OLDER PUERTO RICANS
pmc-10735960.creator: Nekehia Tamara Quashie, Catherine Garcia, Gabriella Meltzer, Flavia Andrade, Amilcar Matos-Moreno
pmc-10735960.description: Cardiometabolic diseases are among the leading causes of mortality worldwide and are increasingly prevalent in rapidly aging populations such as Puerto Rico. Neighborhood socioeconomic position (SEP) and living arrangements are increasingly recognized as important determinants of cardiometabolic health but have not been examined within Puerto Rico.

pmc-11390339.title: Unveiling the uncommon: Gas‐containing renal stones—A unique case study
pmc-11390339.creator: Fahimeh Zeinalkhani, Peyman Kamali Hakim, Mahdiyeh Movahedi, Fatemeh Zare Bozorgabadi, Maryam Movahedi
pmc-11390339.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Key Clinical MessageGas‐containing renal stones are a rare condition. There is an association between renal stones containing gas, urinary tract infection, and renal fusion anomalies, so it is essential to know the radiographic features for prompt diagnosis and treatment.Keywords: computed tomography, gas‐containing stones, horseshoe kidneys, renal stones, urinary tract infections

INTRODUCTION

Gas‐containing renal stones, documented in only 12 cases before this, 1 remain a medical rarity, often associated with recurrent urinary tract infections (UTIs).

pmc-11542042.title: Lateral neck ectopic papillary thyroid carcinoma: A rare case report
pmc-11542042.creator: Miray Ibrahim, Ram Attaf, Mohammed Alhaj Saleh, Hazar Najjoum
pmc-11542042.description: IntroductionEctopic thyroid tissue (ETT) occurs due to abnormal embryogenesis of the thyroid gland. Ectopic thyroid tissue is susceptible to all the processes that affect normal thyroid tissue, including malignant transformation. Malignancy of ectopic thyroid tissue is known as the exceedingly rare phenomenon of ectopic thyroid carcinoma (ETC).

pmc-11547368.title: Transition Metal-Doped Layered Iron Vanadate (FeV3-xMxO9.2.6H2O, M = Co, Mn, Ni, and Zn) for Enhanced Energy Storage Properties
pmc-11547368.creator: Mawuse Amedzo-Adore, Jeong In Han, Teng Zhai
pmc-11547368.description: With its distinctive multiple electrochemical reaction, iron vanadate (FeV3O9.2.6H2O) is considered as a promising electrode material for energy storage. However, it has a relatively low practical specific capacitance. Therefore, using the low temperature sol–gel synthesis process, transition metal doping was used to enhance the electrochemical performance of layered structured FeV3O9.2.6H2O (FVO).

pmc-11550715.title: Reducing the oil absorption and oil deterioration in fried apple slices by ultrasound integrated in infrared frying
pmc-11550715.creator: Ya Su, Shuyi Li, Tiantian Hu, Jieru Zhang, SM Roknul Azam, Aiqing Ren
pmc-11550715.description: The effects of integrated ultrasonic infrared frying (USIF) on the oil absorption of apple slices and the oil deterioration were studied with frequency of 28 and 40 kHz, respectively. Results showed that the heat transfer and moisture migration was accelerated by the integrated ultrasound in IF.

pmc-12685096.title: Time-varying comparative effectiveness of surgical or percutaneous revascularization on patient-centred outcomes
pmc-12685096.creator: Vikram Fielding-Singh, Christian O’Donnell, Jack H. Boyd, Meltem Tuna, Mamas A. Mamas, Marc Ruel, Louise Y. Sun
pmc-12685096.description: Background:Little is known about the comparative risks and timing of patient-defined adverse cardiovascular and noncardiovascular events (PACE) after coronary artery revascularization. We investigated comparative risks of PACEs after coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) or percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).Methods:We conducted a retrospective cohort study of patients who underwent isolated index myocardial revascularization procedures between Oct. 1, 2008, and Dec.

pmc-13068216.title: Association of serum irisin levels with postoperative cognitive dysfunction in older patients following total hip or knee arthroplasty: A prospective observational study
pmc-13068216.creator: Hongxia Zhang, Xue Lin, Yue Zhao, Yuting Zou, Wei Pan, Liangying Yi, Yiping Bai, Daiying Zhang
pmc-13068216.description: BackgroundPostoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD) is a frequent complication in older patients undergoing hip and knee arthroplasty. While irisin has demonstrated benefits in neurological disorders associated with cognitive impairment, its role in POCD remains unclear. This study investigated the association between serum irisin levels and POCD and assessed the discriminative value of irisin for POCD development.

pmc-13073717.title: Resilience-Enhancing Programs for Nurses in the Era of COVID-19: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13073717.creator: Wonjung Noh, Young Ko
pmc-13073717.description: Highlights What are the main findings? A systematic review and meta-analysis of six studies demonstrated that resilience-enhancing programs had a statistically significant positive effect on nurses’ resilience in the post-pandemic era.Despite the overall positive effect, substantial heterogeneity and low-to-very-low certainty of evidence indicate that the magnitude and consistency of the effect should be interpreted cautiously.

pmc-13199453.title: Rare jackpot individuals drive rapid adaptation in Threespine Stickleback
pmc-13199453.creator: Alexander Kwakye, Kerry Reid, Matthew A. Wund, David C. Heins, Michael A. Bell, Krishna R. Veeramah
pmc-13199453.description: Recombination has long been considered the primary mechanism to bring beneficial alleles together, which can increase the speed of adaptation from standing genetic variation. Recombination is fundamental to the transporter hypothesis proposed to explain precise parallel adaptation in Threespine Stickleback.

pmc-13323443.title: Intergroup Encounters Among Wild White-Faced Capuchins (Cebus imitator) at a Densely Populated Field Site: Insights into Frequency, Intensity, and Participation
pmc-13323443.creator: Sarah A Kovalaskas, Agostina Colosimo, Vasco Alexandre Martins, Juan Carlos Ordoñez, Elena Morera Saborío, Jacinta C Beehner, Thore J Bergman, Marcela E Benítez
pmc-13323443.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Intergroup encounters (IGEs) are a major feature of social life for group-living primates, influencing access to resources, reproductive opportunities, and territory. We examined IGE frequency, intensity, and participation in a high-density population of wild white-faced capuchin monkeys (Cebus imitator) at the Capuchinos de Taboga research project in Guanacaste, Costa Rica, using 4 years of data on three capuchin groups (4,984 observation hours, 218 IGEs).

pmc-13394041.title: Heat shock protein 72 attenuates atherosclerosis in apolipoprotein E‐deficient mice
pmc-13394041.creator: Rintaro Yoshizumi, Tatsuya Kondo, Takuro Watanabe, Nobukazu Miyakawa, Sayaka Kitano, Mary Ann Suico, Miki Sato, Masaji Sakaguchi, Motoyuki Igata, Takeshi Matsumura, Hirofumi Kai, Eiichi Araki, Naoto Kubota

pmc-13462575.title: Improvement of the tensile strength of carbon nanotube fibers to 12.5 GPa by fluidics-induced alignment and densification
pmc-13462575.creator: Jian Nong Wang, Yu Ting Chen, Heng Zhang, Hang Zhan, Qing Xuan Wang, Jun Cao, Xi Liu, Jian Feng Zheng, Kang Fei Liu
pmc-13462575.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Achieving the superior tensile strength of individual carbon nanotubes (CNTs) in macroscopic fibers depends on how CNTs are assembled. This study reports a fluidics approach: spraying high-velocity ethanol to scour and shrink pre-made CNT fibers. Experimental measurements show that the continuous scouring and shrinking induce significant improvements of the CNT alignment and packing density, leading to large increases of the van der Waals forces between CNTs and thus the tensile strength of the fibers.

pmc-13582237.title: Raman-guided sample subset selection for cost-efficient offline calibration in bioprocesses
pmc-13582237.creator: Terrance Wilms, Fabian Schwenke, Rudibert King, Steffi Knorn
pmc-13582237.description: In bioprocess engineering, model-based methods play a vital role in understanding complex dynamics of novel species or strains. However, the model development is often hampered by prohibitive costs associated with redundant reference analyses and poorly informed sampling schedules due to insufficient prior knowledge about the process dynamics.

pmc-13592364.title: Intramedullary Ependymoma of the Cervicomedullary Junction: Gross Total Resection and Surgical Nuances in an Anatomically Rare Location
pmc-13592364.creator: Seyed Reza Mousavi, Kamran Hosseini, Hossein Ramezani Abadeh, Mohammadhadi Amir Shahpari Motlagh, Masoud Delavari, Niloofar Borzou, Majid Reza Farrokhi

BackgroundIntramedullary ependymomas are rare, slow-growing tumors (WHO grade II in most cases) arising from the ependymal cells of the spinal cord’s central canal. In this case, histopathological examination confirmed a tanycytic ependymoma (WHO grade II).
